label: Week 35, 2026
recap:
This was a quiet week for US AI policy, with just one bill movement recorded and no case updates or federal documents. All of the activity was concentrated in a single jurisdiction, California, which accounted for the only tracked change.

The lone development touched on workforce and education, specifically training people to use AI, apprenticeships, curriculum, and public literacy programs, illustrated by California AB2504. Its status changed during the week, though this does not mean the bill passed, only that its record was updated. With no other themes, jurisdictions, agencies, or legal proceedings represented in the data, the overall picture for Week 35, 2026 was limited in scope and activity.
